requirements.requirement: Repair the bundle symlinks so they remain symbolic links, use relative paths, and match the intended targets in links.tsv.
requirements.summary: Both absolute links were replaced with relative links: current -> releases/two and latest-report -> releases/two/report.txt. Direct checks show both remain symlinks, resolve successfully, and exactly match links.tsv, including after restart.

requirements.requirement: Ensure the bundle continues to work when copied to another directory.
requirements.summary: A copied bundle retained both relative link values, both links resolved, regular-file hashes matched, and both intended report paths returned the expected content. This behavior was reconfirmed after restart.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the regular files in the bundle.
requirements.summary: The two report files retained their seeded SHA-256 hashes through repair, relocation testing, and restart; copied-file hashes also matched the originals.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the platform.
requirements.summary: The node remained on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 before and after execution. The implementation used existing standard platform utilities and made no package changes; package health remained good.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete: node1 had a healthy pre-restart state, an acknowledged restart, a changed boot ID independently confirmed by lifecycle snapshots, and recovered system, link, report-content, and file-hash state.
limitations: The generic lifecycle snapshot does not inventory the task directory, so final task state relies on the direct executor checks. Those checks are coherent and include post-restart and relocated-copy validation.

The first relocation probe emitted benign sha256 diagnostics when hashing the directory-valued current link, but the subsequent direct relocation test correctly validated that link and the final results are unaffected.
